# The Python packages the unblob-mcp image installs, with their hashes: unblob
# 26.6.4 and what it needs, and the MCP SDK release every cli-sidecar image
# installs, held to the versions ../cli-sidecar/requirements.txt pins.
# setuptools (which fs, a dependency of pyfatfs, imports) is held at 84.1.0,
# the first release past GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w.
# Regenerate from the repository root with
#   printf 'mcp==1.30.0\nunblob==26.6.4\nsetuptools==84.1.0\n' > req.in
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.12 --generate-hashes --no-header \
#       -c services/cli-sidecar/requirements.txt req.in
# and install with pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt.
